source.name: Citroën Racing / Stellantis Media — HRX racewear partnership ahead of season 2027
source.quote: Citroën Racing Formula E Team welcomes HRX as a new partner ahead of new season 2027 of the ABB FIA Formula E World Championship.

note: Racewear partnership announced ahead of the 2027 Formula E season. The release says HRX developed racing suits for the team. Exact contract start, end and value are not stated; no clothing logo position or complete kit sponsor list is asserted.
